## What it is

A slot machine that plays a label's catalog: white-label game engine licensed to artists/labels ($249 solo / $899 label / $2,500+ custom, one-time). Link engine resolves real Spotify/Apple Music/Amazon links.

## Intended use

Artists and labels wanting a catalog-playing slot game for promo/prize engagement.

## Capabilities

- white-label re-skin per catalog
- prize-link engine (Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon verified live)
- promo-prize mode — no gambling
